scope: A dated discovery and compatibility snapshot, not a live version authority. Check each repository and release for newer evidence. The four releases recorded here were read from their GitHub Release pages, including each asset's published SHA-256.

coordination.work_tracking: The existing Linear WuwaTerm project remains authoritative for work tracking.

api.note: API v1 alone does not establish review-v2 or private Web auth-status capability.

manuscript.note: Interchange of saved manuscripts does not certify historical reports against the current dictionary.

terms_database.note: Build or obtain the terms database separately; it is not included in the products.

telegram_state.chat_settings: Unversioned JSON with public and allowed fields.
telegram_state.note: Follow Telegram's state and recovery instructions when moving or upgrading.

api_device_store.format: SQLite devices table, separate from the terms database
api_device_store.note: The observed implementation does not declare a numbered schema; preserve the device store and its SQLite state.

web_selfhost_admission.note: This stores aggregate admission counters, not manuscripts, and is separate from Core's databases.

products.responsibility: Shared dictionary, translation and review logic, HTTP API, data builder and validation, and common deployment and recovery tools.

release.manifest_note: The release manifest records source_commit, the runtime and builder image digests and the pinned upstream data revision: runtime sha256:603d12c646947cad1787fccbe34fc448b503ddfa5304715d1b82720065c04f65 and builder sha256:577f5dc1b534101dcad5f5db150e96c1749532f7df863ddc07af242a6125e008, first pushed as sha-0e64a8e and retagged by promote-images as v0.8.4 and 0.8.
release.note: v0.8.4 imports the complete pinned official Term glossary: 655 Term<n>_Title pairs, 11,987 rows in production. No API shape, prompt, evaluator, retry policy or data pin changed. v0.8.3 and its assets remain published under previous_release.

previous_release.note: Kept as history after v0.8.4; the release and its assets are still published. v0.8.2 and earlier remain on the release page.

candidate_source.note: The 0.7.0 source adds contextual term references and deploy/setup.sh. It was merged as 2ebb3259 and published as v0.7.0; the candidate wheel below belongs to an earlier candidate checkout and is not that source. Kept as history after the release.

candidate_wheel.note: A CI artifact of an earlier candidate checkout, recorded before the release; it is not the published 0.7.0 wheel.

products.adoption_note: Deployment source 0e64a8e on 2026-11-12T18:54:03Z updated Core 0.8.4 (image e16354d) and rebuilt the terms.db served by wuwaterm-api: sha256 425f8679, 11,987 terms, including all 655 Term<n>_Title pairs. The legacy in-Core wuwaterm-bot is retired and stays stopped; the standalone WuwaTerm-Telegram 0.2.8 product serves the Telegram surface and pins this Core release.
products.transition: The observed Core source still contains the legacy Telegram and private Python Web adapters; retirement depends on usable successors.

previous_release.note: Kept as history after v0.2.8; the release and its assets are still published.

previous_release.note: v0.1.1 superseded v0.1.0; both releases and their recorded assets are still published.

products.candidate_note: The two Actions artifacts from candidate_source were never releases; four recorded root/prefix smoke and Core replay commands exited 0. The published v0.1.0 assets were built later from 9f738e71, so their digests differ from these candidates and these archives are history, not release evidence.

publication_validation.note: Recorded while publication was still a read-only rehearsal; the write path was later exercised by the v0.1.0 release.

compatibility.selfhost_requires: A compatible Core API with GET /v1/auth/status and an issued device credential, plus an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy that sets X-WuwaTerm-Edge.
compatibility.note: The Web BFF validates response shapes strictly; a matching API version alone does not prove compatibility.

products.adoption_note: The owner deployed the public Sites site from Web main 6e1337f on 2026-11-12. Web main has since advanced to 5aabe80 with #32-#37; self-hosted release v0.2.0 (5aabe80) is published on GitHub. Public Sites redeploy of 5aabe80 remains pending console upload. This is a source deployment plus a published GitHub release; v0.2.0 is now the published Web product release.

ci_pins.note: These repository pins identify the specified contract-test inputs, not a guarantee for arbitrary version pairs.
